prompts.androgynous:
Create ONLY replacement torso and hips painted sprite layers for the adult androgynous game character in reference image1. Reference image2 contains APPROVED hands and thighs: style, shading, scale references ONLY; do NOT generate or change hand/thigh assets. Required verbatim constraint: “side view, profile, no arm attached, torso ends at the waist.”
FOUR separate transparent cutouts arranged in a 2x2 grid: top left RIGHT-facing TORSO; top right LEFT-facing TORSO; bottom left RIGHT-facing HIPS; bottom right LEFT-facing HIPS. True strict orthographic side elevation, the same viewing angle as the original painting. No three-quarter rotation.
TORSO: headless neck, chest/ribcage side, abdomen, SPINE and lower-back curve, ending just below waist at TOP of hip bone. Remove the entire arm from the painting: NO rounded deltoid shoulder muscle, NO upper-arm cylinder, NO elbow, NO long arm line down the side. The shoulder joint is only a SOFT shallow shoulder curve at the upper torso. The side of the ribcage is visible with natural soft skin shading; upper arm will be an independent overlay. Back outline continuous from shoulder to waist. NO buttock bulge on torso. Short torso only: neck through waist, about 310 native source pixels tall, NOT neck through buttock. Bottom ends in soft rounded painted overlap extending 12 native pixels below waist, with NO dark straight horizontal cut/seam.
HIPS: side-profile waist/top hip bone through buttock and first 20% of thighs, about 170 native source pixels tall. Waist must match torso position and width exactly when assembled. Buttock appears ONLY as the modest rear-edge curve, never a full round cheek facing camera, never a rear or three-quarter back view. Front edge is hip/front of thigh, not the buttock. Short under-buttock crease on the BACK only. Lower thigh attachments are narrow, simple rounded painted overlaps with NO two half-circle bumps. Preserve original buttock depth and silhouette from reference1, matching the approved thigh width reference2. Two views mirror the DIRECTIONS, not a change of anatomical build.
Keep original anatomy and paint: neutral gray sculptural skin shading; original androgynous chest and waist proportions. Clear original dark brown/charcoal contour, soft painted shading, no flat gradient fills. Clean genuine transparency outside dark contour, fully opaque skin inside. REMOVE all red/yellow/orange halo and stray colored specks; do not copy fringes from originals. No colored registration marks, labels, frames, background or extra parts. Use a shared identical scale for all four cutouts, leave ample transparent separation. Preserve visible body contours/shading; paint only the concealed torso and hip surfaces necessary to separate layers. Deliver finished painted source parts, not complete people, not arm silhouettes.
